race.comment: CROWN THE KING (2) has the strongest class case despite finishing eleventh in a BM64 at Kembla Grange, where he was beaten four and a half lengths and lacked the same turn of foot after travelling midfield. The return from provincial company looks a genuine plus, and his overall profile rates well enough to make him the one to beat. BOTTAS (1) was sound first-up at Bendigo from a rearward position and returns to a distance range where he has already won and placed, with proven form at this venue adding weight. CLASSIC TOUCH (6) has been fourth in both runs this campaign, the latest in Class 2 company at Canberra, and should be ready to peak third-up. MASAKARI (3) got the maiden win out of the way in grand style over 1600m at this track last start. Senior rider hops aboard and he doesn't get the same map favours today. Place preferred.
